description: Fires right after the opponent drops a stone into column 0 (the far-left edge) when column 0 is now tall: 4+ stones (3 only very early). Stronger the taller column 0 and the earlier in the game (peaks around ply 16-20, fades after ~ply 25-35). Weakened when I (the side to move) own more of column 0 than the opponent, or none of it. Any other last move: no firing.
effect: Weak: forcing it high or off changes move probabilities by at most about 5-7 points, with no consistent column.
notes: Layer 0. Every firing dev example has last move col 0. act: activation rises ~1.5 per col-0 stone, falls ~0.25/ply after ply 16; first stone in col 0 is strongly negative. Colour mix matters (more of mover's stones up; excess of mine down). Full columns elsewhere (esp. 1,2) lower it in act tests but a penalty hurt dev (F1 .73). Scores: .733, .775, .732, .800, .690, .834, .841 (final; P .81 R .87, AUROC .93, sim share .65). Rule is a formula over h, ply and colour counts; boundary noisy near ply 25-35.
